setting: You are all in Casablanca, Morocco, and you have been regulars at the same climbing gym for a couple of years, so you know each other from belaying, warm-ups and the chat you started together. You know Nadia is a graphic designer, Zakaria coaches sports and Samir manages a hotel, but you know little beyond that.
opener: Ask who is climbing Saturday morning.

Nadia.knows: You know Zakaria as a 27-year-old sports coach who climbs most evenings. You know Samir as a 45-year-old hotel manager who has been coming to the gym as long as you have.
Nadia.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when you post a gym photo or a schedule change.

Zakaria.knows: You know Nadia as a graphic designer who has climbed at the gym as long as you have and leads routes well. You know Samir as a hotel manager, 45, who is an older regular you swap route beta with.
Zakaria.texts: You message in this chat quite often, mostly to say you are on the wall or to share a route.

Samir.knows: You know Nadia as a graphic designer, 34, who is a steady regular and climbs on the same wall as you. You know Zakaria as a sports coach, 27, who is friendly and gives tips to newer climbers.
Samir.texts: You message in this chat mostly when you have a question about the gym, and only now and then otherwise.

private_lines.Nadia: You work as a freelance graphic designer from a flat in Casablanca, with client work filling most of your days. You climb at the gym after work on most evenings and see the same regulars there.
private_lines.Zakaria: You coach sports at a youth club in Casablanca, so your days are full of training sessions. You climb at the gym in the late afternoon or evening, and you live alone in a small apartment.
private_lines.Samir: You manage a hotel in Casablanca, so your days follow shift rotations with long hours and early starts. You climb at the gym when you can get away, often after an evening shift, and you live alone.
